title: Ko da sassa, braids marasa kulli da tashin hankali mai aminci
course_title: Kula da Gashi & Salon Sauƙaƙe: Ayyukan Sabis na Salon

say: Ko da sassa, braids marasa kulli da tashin hankali mai aminci.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module 3 na Kula da gashi da Salon Sauƙi.
Abokan ciniki suna yin hukunci da salo da farko ta sassan sa. Har ila yau, sassan ma suna nufin ko da nauyi, don haka babu wani ƙaramin sashi da ya takura.
A cikin grid mai murabba'i, sassan suna layi kamar allon darasi. Suna da kyau sosai idan an ɗaure su, amma layukan fatar kai suna nunawa lokacin da ɗigon ya rataye sako-sako.

panel.heading: Girkin murabba'i ko bulo-laying
left: Da kyau sosai idan an ɗaure
Layukan ƙoƙon kai suna nunawa lokacin sako-sako
right: Kowane jere ya canza rabin sashe
Mafi kyawun murfin fatar kai yana rataye
Layukan musanya a cikin ƙidayar ƙirƙira

say: A cikin bulo-layin, kowane jere ana jujjuya shi da rabin sashe, kamar tubalin da ke bango, don haka fatar kan mutum yana da kyau a rufe idan an rataye sarƙoƙi. Zaɓi samfurin tare da abokin ciniki.

say: Fara a nape. Zana layi na farko kuma a cire duk gashin da ke sama.

say: Raba jeri zuwa sassa daidai, yin amfani da yatsunsu azaman mai mulki.

say: Yi layi gaba ɗaya kafin ku raba na gaba. Tambaye ta ta kiyaye matakin haƙarta, kuma kowane layuka 2, duba baya tare da hoton waya.

panel.rule: Kowane layuka 2, ɗauki hoton waya daga baya kuma duba masu girma dabam.

say: Misali, A’isha a Kano tana shirin gyare-gyaren matsakaitan akwati a cikin bulo, mai layuka 8. Layuka huɗu suna riƙe da ƙwanƙwasa 10, wanda shine 40. Layukan da aka canjawa wuri guda huɗu suna riƙe da 9 kowanne, wanda shine 36.

panel.heading: Ƙidaya kafin ka faɗi
items: 4 layuka na 10 braids = 40 braids
Layuka 4 da aka canjawa wuri na 9 braids = 36 braids
Jimlar: 76 ƙwanƙwasa
Minti 76 x 6 = mintuna 456

say: Wato 76 braids. A lokacin ta na mintuna 6 kowanne, wato mintuna 456, kusan awanni 7 da mintuna 36 na gyaran gashi. Yanzu za ta iya faɗi lokaci kuma ta sayi gashin da ya dace.

say: Knotless braids suna kallon asali a tushen saboda nauyin yana ginawa a hankali. Fara da dinki 2 ko 3 na gashin kanta kawai, mai ƙarfi amma mara zafi.

panel.heading: Gina kwali ɗaya mara knotless
items: Dinki 2 ko 3 da gashin kanta kawai
Ajiye ɗan sirara, naɗe-kaɗen ciyarwa a kan ƙwanƙwasa
Gyara ƴan dinki, ƙara yanki na gaba
Dakatar da ƙara a kauri da aka yarda
Duba: babu gashin kai, babu tug a tushen

say: Ajiye ɗan siraran gashin tsawa, wanda aka naɗe shi cikin rabi, a kan ƙwanƙwasa don kowane rabi ya haɗu da gefen gefe.

say: Misali, Tola da ke Legas ya tsara ƙulli 60 marasa kulli tare da guda 3 kowanne. Wato guda 180 kenan. Tana samun kusan guda 30 a cikin fakiti ɗaya, don haka tana buƙatar fakiti 6, tare da fakiti ɗaya.
Fakiti daya ya kai kimanin naira 1,200.
Don haka fakiti 7 sun kai kimanin naira 8,400. Ta gaya wa abokin ciniki a gaba kuma ta rubuta shi akan katin rikodin.
Yawancin masu salo suna rufe ƙarshen roba a cikin ruwan zafi, kuma yana ƙonewa da sauri. Ka sanya tawul a wuyanta da kafadu, ka nemi ta karkata, sannan ka nisanta wa yara tulun.

panel.heading: Rufewa yana ƙarewa da ruwan zafi

cards.d: Towel a wuyanta da kafadu. Ta sunkuyar da kanta. Kettle akan barga mai tsayi, nesa da yara.
Rike kofin da kyau a ƙasa kafadunta kuma tsoma iyakar kawai. Babu bude wuta kusa da kai.
Sanya shi a ƙarƙashin ruwa mai tsabta mai tsabta. Nemi taimakon likita don wani abu fiye da ƙarami, ƙananan kuna.

say: Riƙe kofin da kanka, da kyau a ƙasa da kafadu, kuma ku tsoma iyakar kawai. Kada a taɓa zuba ruwan zafi akan ƙwanƙwasa kusa da fatarta. Gashin roba na iya kama wuta, don haka kada a yi amfani da wuta kusa da kanta.

say: Alopecia na jujjuyawa shine asarar gashi daga maimaita ja. Sau da yawa yana farawa a haikalin, kuma ja na dogon lokaci zai iya sa ya zama dindindin.
Idan ta yi nasara ko ta ce yana da zafi, tsaya ta sake gyara sashin a hankali.

say: Gudanar da wannan cak a farkon, a kowane jere, kuma kafin ta tafi. Tambayi ciwon baya. Bar layin gashi kyauta kuma fara masara sirara. Babu tanti, babu zafi.
Kwas ɗin bayanin kula da cututtukan fata ya ba da shawarar tsawaita tsawon watanni 2 ko 3 a mafi yawan lokuta, don haka amince da ranar cirewa kuma tunatar da ita mako guda kafin.

panel.heading: Duban tashin hankali
items: Tambayi ciwon baya
An bar gashin gashi kyauta
Babu tantin fatar kan mutum
Babu ciwo a kowane jere
An amince da ranar cirewa

say: Don tunawa. Ko da sassa na nufin ko da nauyi. Ƙirƙiri ƙididdiga da fakitin gashi kafin ka faɗi. Ƙara nauyin tsawo a hankali. Hatimi ya ƙare lafiya. Kuma idan ya yi zafi, yana da matsewa. Yaro bai kamata ya bar kujerar ku cikin zafi ba.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Ko da sassa na nufin ko da nauyi
Kidaya braids da fakiti kafin ka faɗi
Knotless da feed-ins suna ƙara nauyi a hankali
Ruwan zafi: tawul, nisa, ƙarewa kawai, babu harshen wuta
Idan ya yi zafi, ya matse sosai: sake gyara shi

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Raba kan kai a cikin duka alamu kuma ƙidaya braids. Sanya braids marasa kulli goma da lokaci kowanne. Sa'an nan kuma yi hudu ciyar-in cornrows, neman ta'aziyya maki bayan kowace jere.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Sashe kuma ƙidaya cikakken kai a cikin duka alamu
Shigar da braids marasa knotless guda goma kuma ka sanya su lokaci
Ciyarwar guda huɗu a cikin masara tare da gunkin tashin hankali
